Container.Name: FlexDav
Container.Overview:
A read-only WebDAV bridge in front of a remote media server. Works with Plex. Mount it with rclone and union it with a writable local folder through mergerfs; no copy of the media is kept, reads are proxied upstream as HTTP range requests.
SETUP: create /mnt/user/appdata/flexdav/.env from .env.example in the repository, chmod 600, and put PLEX_BASE_URL and PLEX_TOKEN in it. The token belongs in that file and nowhere else. Templates live on the flash drive in plain text, which is why this one carries no secrets.
The port is bound in Extra Parameters rather than as a Port mapping, so it stays on 127.0.0.1. The endpoint exposes the entire library to anyone who can reach it, so do not publish it to the LAN.
Container.Requires: An rclone mount pointed at http://127.0.0.1:8099, and mergerfs if you want a writable branch beside the remote media.
